<!-- zh -->
## 改进

- **免费额度入口** — 设置页 API Key 下方新增免费额度链接：用百炼且地域为北京时，直达百炼的免费额度页手动开通（新加坡地域开通百炼后自动发放，不显示）；用 Gemini 时，链接到 AI Studio 的用量限制页。额度以控制台实际显示为准。
- 只能自动识别源语言的接口（Qwen3.8、OpenAI、Gemini）直接显示「自动检测」，不再给出只有一项的下拉框，交换按钮也一并隐藏；之前存过的源语言不会再让它显示成空白。

## 移除

- **Qwen3 预设** — 百炼的文档、价目表和模型列表都已撤下 `qwen3-livetranslate-flash-realtime`，翻译模型里去掉这一项，接口名改为「Qwen3.5」。已经选了它的配置照常保留（显示为自定义模型），语言列表仍限它支持的 18 种。

## 修复

- 设置按钮的图标改为齿轮，和说明里的「右上角齿轮」一致。

## 安装与打开

需要一个 API Key：[阿里云百炼](https://bailian.console.aliyun.com/cn-beijing/model/settings/api-key)、[OpenAI](https://platform.openai.com/api-keys) 、[Google AI Studio](https://aistudio.google.com/apikey) 或[豆包语音控制台](https://console.volcengine.com/speech/new/setting/apikeys)任选其一（豆包要先在[开通管理](https://console.volcengine.com/speech/new/setting/activate)里手动开通同声传译）。首次打开后点右上角齿轮，选好接口再填入 Key。

### Windows 10 / 11

1. 下载 [`ReaLingo_0.7.1_x64-setup.exe`](https://github.com/noSugarK/ReaLingo/releases/download/v0.7.1/ReaLingo_0.7.1_x64-setup.exe)（推荐）或 [`ReaLingo_0.7.1_x64_en-US.msi`](https://github.com/noSugarK/ReaLingo/releases/download/v0.7.1/ReaLingo_0.7.1_x64_en-US.msi)，双击安装。
2. 安装包没有代码签名，SmartScreen 可能提示「Windows 已保护你的电脑」：点 **更多信息 → 仍要运行**。
3. 从开始菜单打开 ReaLingo。Windows 11 会把托盘图标折叠进 `^`，想常驻就拖到任务栏上。

### macOS 12+（Intel 与 Apple Silicon 通用）

1. 下载 [`ReaLingo_0.7.1_universal.dmg`](https://github.com/noSugarK/ReaLingo/releases/download/v0.7.1/ReaLingo_0.7.1_universal.dmg)，打开后把 ReaLingo 拖进「应用程序」。
2. 应用没有经过 Apple 公证，首次打开会被拦下（提示「已损坏」或「无法验证开发者」）。在终端执行一次：
   ```bash
   xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/ReaLingo.app
   ```
   或者先打开一次，再到 **系统设置 → 隐私与安全性**，在页面下方点 **仍要打开**。
3. 首次用麦克风 / 系统声音时会弹权限申请，点允许。系统声音需要 **macOS 14.4+**。

### Linux（Ubuntu 22.04+）

1. 下载 [`ReaLingo_0.7.1_amd64.deb`](https://github.com/noSugarK/ReaLingo/releases/download/v0.7.1/ReaLingo_0.7.1_amd64.deb)，用 apt 安装（会自动拉依赖，`dpkg -i` 不会）：
   ```bash
   sudo apt install ./ReaLingo_0.7.1_amd64.deb
   ```
2. 从应用菜单打开 ReaLingo，或在终端运行 `realingo`。
3. 系统声音需要 PulseAudio 或 PipeWire（Ubuntu 桌面默认就有）。托盘图标不响应左键，用右键菜单里的「显示主窗口」。

## Improved

- **Free quota links** — Settings now links to the free quota under the API key: with Model Studio in the Beijing region, straight to the free-quota page where you switch it on (Singapore grants it automatically once Model Studio is activated, so no link there); with Gemini, to the rate-limit page in AI Studio. The console has the final word on the amount.
- APIs that only detect the source language themselves (Qwen3.8, OpenAI, Gemini) now show "Auto-detect" outright instead of a one-item dropdown, and hide the swap button; a source saved earlier no longer leaves it blank.

## Removed

- **The Qwen3 preset** — Model Studio has dropped `qwen3-livetranslate-flash-realtime` from its docs, price list and model list, so it is gone from the model presets and the API is now called "Qwen3.5". A config that already names it keeps it (shown as a custom model), still limited to its 18 languages.

## Fixed

- The settings button is a gear again, matching the "gear in the top-right" the instructions mention.

## Install

You need an API key from [Alibaba Cloud Model Studio](https://bailian.console.aliyun.com/ap-southeast-1/model/settings/api-key), [OpenAI](https://platform.openai.com/api-keys), [Google AI Studio](https://aistudio.google.com/apikey) or the [Doubao Speech console](https://console.volcengine.com/speech/new/setting/apikeys) (for Doubao, switch on simultaneous interpretation under [Activation](https://console.volcengine.com/speech/new/setting/activate) first). On first launch, click the gear in the top-right, pick the API and paste the key.

### Windows 10 / 11

1. Download [`ReaLingo_0.7.1_x64-setup.exe`](https://github.com/noSugarK/ReaLingo/releases/download/v0.7.1/ReaLingo_0.7.1_x64-setup.exe) (recommended) or [`ReaLingo_0.7.1_x64_en-US.msi`](https://github.com/noSugarK/ReaLingo/releases/download/v0.7.1/ReaLingo_0.7.1_x64_en-US.msi) and run it.
2. The installer is not code-signed, so SmartScreen may say "Windows protected your PC": click **More info → Run anyway**.
3. Open ReaLingo from the Start menu. Windows 11 folds new tray icons under `^`; drag it onto the taskbar to keep it visible.

### macOS 12+ (universal: Intel and Apple Silicon)

1. Download [`ReaLingo_0.7.1_universal.dmg`](https://github.com/noSugarK/ReaLingo/releases/download/v0.7.1/ReaLingo_0.7.1_universal.dmg), open it and drag ReaLingo into Applications.
2. The app is not notarised, so the first launch is blocked ("damaged" or "unidentified developer"). Run once in Terminal:
   ```bash
   xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/ReaLingo.app
   ```
   or open it once, then click **Open Anyway** at the bottom of **System Settings → Privacy & Security**.
3. Allow the microphone / system audio permission when asked. System audio needs **macOS 14.4+**.

### Linux (Ubuntu 22.04+)

1. Download [`ReaLingo_0.7.1_amd64.deb`](https://github.com/noSugarK/ReaLingo/releases/download/v0.7.1/ReaLingo_0.7.1_amd64.deb) and install it with apt (which pulls in dependencies; `dpkg -i` does not):
   ```bash
   sudo apt install ./ReaLingo_0.7.1_amd64.deb
   ```
2. Open ReaLingo from the app menu, or run `realingo` in a terminal.
3. System audio needs PulseAudio or PipeWire (standard on the Ubuntu desktop). The tray icon ignores left clicks; use "Show main window" in its right-click menu.
